tools.name: practice_question
tools.description: One question from Szymon Paluch's free, unofficial practice exams for the Claude certifications: ccar-f = Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (60 questions); ccar-p = Claude Certified Architect – Professional (63 questions); ccao-f = Claude Certified Associate – Foundations (60 questions); ccdv

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search Szymon Paluch's blog (agentic engineering, AI implementation, Claude certification, AI in companies). Returns matching posts with title, date, summary, slug and URL. Every post exists in English and Polish under the same slug.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: Full text of one blog post as Markdown, with its URL, date and FAQ. Takes the slug from search_posts, or the post URL.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Szymon Paluch's services (AI implementation, consulting, workshops, speaking, the Certified AI Consultant Program) with indicative prices in PLN (net, primary) and USD (converted). Final quotes are scoped per engagement.

tools.name: get_speaking
tools.description: Szymon Paluch's conference talks, meetups, podcasts and trainings since 2020, newest first. Only engagements verified against a public source.

tools.name: book_a_call
tools.description: The link to book a call with Szymon Paluch, plus his email and phone.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, read_post · Public sink: search_posts, read_post, book_a_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, read_post · Public sink: search_posts, read_post, book_a_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
